resources.string: Personal media sync
Optional manual subscription and resume sync with your self-hosted service. Playback and DD control remain local.
Sign in with a code
In your sync portal, select Connect a device. Enter the service address and the one-time code it shows. The code works once and expires after 10 minutes.

That code was not accepted. It may be mistyped, used already or expired. Create a new code in the portal.
Check the code. It has 26 letters and numbers, usually shown in groups of four.
Enter the service address starting with https://, with no path after it.
Enter a device name of up to 96 bytes.
Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
Your account has reached its device limit. Revoke an old device in the portal first.
Import protected enrollment
Choose the owner-created enrollment file and enter its passphrase. Keep the protected recovery copy private. No provider accounts or automatic playback.

This affects sync enrollment or resolves all current conflicts. Local playback remains available. Continue?
Disconnected. Your library remains local.
Connected. Select Sync now to exchange subscriptions and resume positions.
Sync complete.
Service unavailable. Local playback and pending changes remain available.
Local changes are waiting. Select Sync now to send them.
Conflicting changes are retained locally. Choose which versions to keep for all conflicts.
Service restore detected. Uploads are paused; local changes are retained and reconciliation is required.
Sync could not finish. Local data is retained. Check enrollment, service availability and storage limits.
Media sync requires Android 8 or newer. Local playback is unaffected.
Include playlists, Watch Later and history

Also sync playlist names, ordered YouTube videos (up to 200 per list), Watch Later and latest per-video watch times? A separate shared Watch Later list is created; existing names are not matched. Update and opt in every connected client. Disconnect to stop; existing remote copies remain.
Update the service and every client, then enable playlists, Watch Later and history on this device.
A playlist cannot sync. Lists must contain at most 200 YouTube videos and a nonempty name of at most 160 UTF-8 bytes. Nothing was truncated.
